name: Sean Esbjörn-Hargens
reason: Too thin: he has no personal site; his own projects are exostudies.org (UFO/UAP and entity-encounter studies, with a contact form) and metaintegral.com (a social-impact design firm). Every course on exostudies.org is past (the latest ran June to October 2025), he now works as a company people-and-culture officer, his books are academic integral-theory titles that could not be confirmed (Open Library refused the connection), and neither site mentions The Shift Network. No current offerings or free resources to list.
